title_1080p: GOR-9 • Inverse-Keplerian Elliptical Drone Orbit Seamless Loop (14,285.7 kHz USB • 0400 GCT)
description:
Seamless 54-second Inverse-Keplerian elliptical inspection drone loop around the 86.5m High Basalt Shelf Broadcast Tower on Asteroid 3-5-1, 42,100 AU out in Oort Cloud Sector 9.
Unlike a comet that accelerates at periapsis, the camera drone slows down on close approach to take in the architectural details across 3 ascending periapsis bypasses, and accelerates out into wide elliptical apoapsis turns over Acheron Chasm before the finale 50 kW Marzelvane burst.
